### Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – July 14, 2026

#### Summer Games 2026

Summer Games 2026 is LIVE, bringing your favorite beach brawls back to the arcade! Blast into Lucioball, crank things up with Lucioball Remix, or serve up some fun in Winston's Beach Volleyball while completing challenges to earn sizzling summertime loot. Soak up the sun and earn a shining victory in Summer Games 2026, July 14 – 30!

#### Junkrat's Loot Hunt

Junkrat’s Loot Hunt returns from July 31 - August 3 for a reward-fueled weekend blast! Every match you play pushes you closer to Loot Boxes, with flexible challenges that let you go all-in or pace yourself. Plus, progress won't reset, there's no daily pressure, and no nonsense… just explosions, and piles of loot to unbox!

#### Excavation Initiative

The Excavation Initiative continues, rewarding you for doing what you'd already be doing: playing Overwatch. Throughout the rest of the season, you'll earn Loot Boxes simply by logging in, completing challenges, winning games, and staying active week after week. The more you play, the more opportunities you'll have to uncover Base, Epic, and Legendary Loot Boxes packed with rewards.

#### Hero Updates

#### Tank

![Doomfist](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/c1eq/256X256/36dc867dd65cff81b5154c34531a9c520059c6f8c907631a6f99e049a6777dbb-t.png)

##### Doomfist

Empowered Rocket Punch's increased follow-through size was hitting targets far away from the initial target. We're reducing the bonus size while retaining some additional range and radius to preserve its power fantasy.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/OwEm/128X128/79fa2ac1beeaaecc23735e2bc41068a99838c76ff626a12ac07fcdc5efd70bd9-t.png)

Rocket Punch

* Empowered Punch collateral range gain reduced 75% to 40%.
* Empowered Punch collateral radius gain reduced from 50% to 40%.

![Junker Queen](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### Junker Queen

Commanding Shout is Junker Queen's primary source of survivability and team protection. Its cooldown begins after the effect expires, resulting in a longer time between uses. We're reducing the cooldown to increase its availability during engagements.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/TYKY/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-04-t.png)

Commanding Shout

* Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds. (5v5)
* Cooldown reduced from 15 to 13 seconds. (6v6)

![Mauga](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cI5S/256X256/937cbae13f50502b4191c09b7c178ef60d2eadddcdda5bc4268c1541216b8722-t.png)

##### Mauga

Mauga could maintain high accuracy when firing a single Chaingun for extended periods. Adding dynamic spread to individual Chainguns encourages switching between weapons to manage spread. This change does not affect accuracy while firing both weapons simultaneously.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/qcBJ/239X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-06-t.png)

Chainguns

* Maximum spread while firing individual Chainguns increased from 1 to 1.5.
* Number of shots until maximum spread increased from 0 to 30 shots.

![Ramattra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/m8EN/256X256/f54a877264e161c2aa4d5755ef4411eb7fd7e4eb910075936e91ddb043b8a58e-t.png)

##### Ramattra

Increasing Ravenous Vortex's explosion damage rewards more precise detonations. We're also reducing Block's cooldown to allow Ramattra to block immediately after a single punch instead of two, improving the flow of Nemesis Form.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/73x0/128X128/80e96eddbc10af5e1b08c7392f4f61aabc0e5408e31e72961595a936ccceabcc-t.png)

Ravenous Vortex

* Explosion damage increased from 15 to 30.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/kl23/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-09-t.png)

Block (Nemesis Form)

* Cooldown reduced from 1 to 0.5 seconds.

![Sigma](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/o3YX/256X256/416f312608ac1d9f34509883daa0fa9486b15ceb112e4440b4c412e125390517-t.png)

##### Sigma

Sigma remains durable when successfully rotating through his defensive tools. Reducing his shield health lowers his survivability when opponents are able to break through his defenses.

* Shield health reduced from 275 to 250.

Hyper Regeneration – Minor Perk

* Damage conversion reduced from 40% to 30%.

#### Damage

![Cassidy](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6VR5/256X256/5a0a0840565c5810d9a638d391b0403ba743459d52aa9f1c443a9fc87e41f06f-t.png)

##### Cassidy

Silver Bullet's additional projectile size improved the perk's effectiveness by making the empowered shot significantly easier to land. We're removing that bonus while retaining its potential damage.

Silver Bullet – Major Perk

* Projectile size reduced from 0.17 to 0.07.

![Freja](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/gboy/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-63-t.png)

##### Freja

Reducing Take Aim's explosion delay lowers the time between impact and damage, creating more consistent follow-up opportunities while reducing the bolt's disruptive potential when hit by it. The other changes are aimed at improving the flow between Take Aim and Revdraw Crossbow’s primary fire.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/00Na/251X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-13-t.png)

Revdraw Crossbow

* Fire Rate increased from 5 to 5.5.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zTnk/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-67-t.png)

Take Aim

* Recovery reduced from 0.5 to 0.4.
* Explosion delay reduced from 1 to 0.8 seconds.

![Reaper](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/qp7k/256X256/d6d7be4b019c088741f1a27bf643bc3718f06f571fe185441026aaef03115843-t.png)

##### Reaper

Reaper's reduced health pool has limited his ability to sustain through extended engagements. Increasing the effectiveness of his passive restores some of that durability while rewarding aggressive play.

Soul Reaving – Minor Perk

* Pickup radius of Soul Globes increased from 5 to 8 meters.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/vQcJ/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-16-t.png)

The Reaping

* Lifesteal increased from 25% to 30%.

![Shion](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zyDD/256X256/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-01-t.png)

##### Shion

Reducing Execution's recovery time better aligns the downtime after using the ability with when Shion can fire again. Joyride's impact damage is also being reduced to lower the effectiveness of continuously ramming targets and the combo potential of immediately detonating the bike after impact.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/ftAn/128X128/patch-2026-06-25-8499295f51-02-t.png)

Execution

* Recovery time reduced from 0.4 to 0.3 seconds.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/V9Eo5othcvoaGhZB4-lu8Q/20260715/naJx/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-19.png)

Joyride

* Impact damage while riding reduced from 60 to 30.

![Sierra](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/P2Fo/256X256/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-01-t.png)

##### Sierra

Anchor Drone is being adjusted to support more frequent deployment and repositioning opportunities. Its cooldown and duration are being reduced, while its health is being increased to improve its survivability in combat.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/LOmt/128X128/patch-2026-04-17-eee184f317-05-t.png)

Anchor Drone

* Cooldown reduced from 12 to 11 seconds.
* Duration reduced from 10 to 9 seconds.
* Health increased from 80 to 125.

![Vendetta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/iADD/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-31-t.png)

##### Vendetta

Vendetta has continued to underperform since the significant changes made several seasons ago. Reverting Palatine Fang's overhead swing range restores some of her ability to close the distance and secure eliminations.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/3x4g/354X108/9754a770516c07712b3cbababb825972eec78c08b3fbc141dbcee31d9c58c137-t.png)

Palatine Fang

* Overhead swing bonus range increased from 2.0 to 2.5 meters.

![Venture](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/DcTa/256X256/7cab11e20f958ed3d369989e0ac96703fd2cda8c7abf237f75e12bf3549b066e-t.png)

##### Venture

Clobber's cooldown is being reduced to shorten the delay before Venture can use the ability again and better align it with its recovery time. This increases the frequency with which Clobber can be used within engagements and improves its synergy with the Covered in Dirt Major Perk.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/rfGw/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-25-t.png)

Clobber (Quick Melee)

* Cooldown/Recovery reduced from 1.6 to 1.2 seconds.

#### Support

![Ana](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FfFC/256X256/3c87d470067d61c432815a4bc0c70b11f1b5379006da29625839da356b7c4ca1-t.png)

##### Ana

Ana's self-sustain has decreased following the removal of the Support passive's reduced health regeneration delay. Increasing Biotic Grenade's healing strengthens its defensive utility while also increasing its offensive impact.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/6EZX/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-27-t.png)

Biotic Grenade

* Explosion damage and healing increased from 75 to 90.

![Brigitte](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/zUCN/256X256/dbc7d49f32020fed1033cb4bb99b55f7938d1a71108fe76edc589e42c8cd0977-t.png)

##### Brigitte

Adding a burst of instant healing when Inspire is triggered allows Brigitte to provide more immediate healing while rewarding players for consistent Inspire triggers.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Z5wl/128X128/patch-2026-05-12-4b3a5430c9-04-t.png)

Inspire

* Now grants 12 instant healing on trigger.
* Healing over time reduced from 60 to 45.

![Kiriko](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)

##### Kiriko

The reduced recovery time on Healing Ofuda improved the feel and consistency of Kiriko's healing. However, her overall healing output has become too high, so we're reducing the base healing while preserving the improved responsiveness.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/PmZ5/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-147-t.png)

Healing Ofuda

* Healing per projectile reduced from 13 to 12.

![Lúcio](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cqpF/256X256/3a804d4305621bbee0e1472ac79d977799a27b6ae8f44922790cd1393812d5fd-t.png)

##### Lúcio

Lúcio's overall effectiveness has been reduced over time to account for his uniquely powerful speed utility. Increasing his weapon damage strengthens his offensive capabilities without increasing the strength of his utility.

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/7JVs/160X132/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-33-t.png)

Sonic Amplifier

* Damage per projectile increased from 20 to 22.

#### Stadium Updates

General Changes

* Clash capture speed now increased up to 300% as time elapses (Up from 200%).
* Rate at which Clash capture speed increases increased to 2% every 1s (Up from 1%).

Clash rounds in Stadium can lead to outlier match lengths, especially in compositions with high amounts of sustain, so we're increasing the point capture speed to limit such outliers.

#### Tank

![Junker Queen](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### Junker Queen

* Damage reduced to 20 (Down from 25).

Bow Down - Power

![Cassidy](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6VR5/256X256/5a0a0840565c5810d9a638d391b0403ba743459d52aa9f1c443a9fc87e41f06f-t.png)

* Max Life Heal per bullet reloaded increased to 2.5% (Up from 2%).

![Junkrat](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/5VCF/256X256/f807df911fec53e9c86107affc4d7a5c08612ae0de1baafe7c12352a048b9b52-t.png)

Zip Grease - Power

![Mei](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/qfDl/256X256/dc5525ecbba3b254188f126ba0dd07571dee201d4ddc2f068c3e2f6907668cca-t.png)

Slowball - Power

* Removed increased hitbox size on Slowball projectile.

Frost Armor - Power

* Damage converted to Armor reduced to 3% (Down from 5%).

![Reaper](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/qp7k/256X256/d6d7be4b019c088741f1a27bf643bc3718f06f571fe185441026aaef03115843-t.png)

##### Reaper

Accelerated Reaping - Power

* Attack Speed per stack increased to 5% (Up from 4%).

Dauntless Draught - Epic Survival Hero Item

* Wraith Form Duration reduced to 33% (Down from 50%).

![Torbjörn](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/nXs8/256X256/b1b376c95ed7f017b9be712c9069305c7e5cb26b010aa988697805ffa1cc20a5-t.png)

Hammer Throw - Power

* Added a VFX Trail for added clarity.

Blacksmith - Power

* Heal increased to 100% of Hammer damage (Up from 75%).

Come Get Yer Armor - Power

Anchor Bolts - Epic Ability Hero Item

#### Support

![Juno](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/V9Eo5othcvoaGhZB4-lu8Q/20260715/dXGL/256X256/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-40.png)

##### Juno

This change should reduce the ceiling of Blink Boost when paired with multiple other Cooldown Reduction items. We'll continue to monitor Blink Boost's synergy with On Ability items.

Blink Boosts - Power

* Reduced Cooldown now counts as base cooldown reduced instead of gaining cooldown reduction. Now scales multiplicatively with cooldown reduction instead of additively.

![Kiriko](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)

##### Kiriko

Clone Conjuration - Power

* Clone effectiveness increased to 65% reduced (Up from 75% reduced).

Keen Kunai - Power

* Cooldown reduction per critical hit increased to 20% (Up from 15%).

![Lúcio](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cqpF/256X256/3a804d4305621bbee0e1472ac79d977799a27b6ae8f44922790cd1393812d5fd-t.png)

##### Lúcio

Rhythm Rail - Power

* Damage increased to 100% (Up from 75%).

Crowd Pleaser - Power

* Heal increased to 40% of Soundwave Damage (Up from 33%).

![Mercy](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/h0V1/256X256/55e281170eb6d65b2bece475b1179ccf37810dfb46b957705227d566cb38be9e-t.png)

##### Mercy

Distortion - Power

* Max Life Overhealth reduced to 25% (Down from 30%).

![Wuyang](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/fPiL/256X256/patch-2026-06-16-b1720c272e-50-t.png)

##### Wuyang

* Currency from damage and healing increased by 8.33%.

![Zenyatta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Zqgs/256X256/58a05fe509b6b5333a4e3bf761afab6493420bf58fa2fac834ca1d3f779961d2-t.png)

##### Zenyatta

Enlightenment - Power

* Heal reduced to 30% of damage dealt (Down from 40%).

Inner Peace - Power

* Healing reduced to 80% reduced (Down from 75% reduced).

Item Changes

Volskaya Ordnance - Epic Weapon General Item

* Bonus Damage per 100 Bonus Life on target increased to 6% (Up from 5%).

Gadget Maximizer - Epic Ability General Item

* Gadget cooldown reduction increased to 35% (Up from 25%).

Three Tap Tommygun - Epic Ability General Item

* Added 0.5s internal cooldown for subsequent applications.
* Damage reduced to 3% of target's current life (Down from 5%).
* Damage duration reduced to 3s (Down from 5s).

Vortex Vial - Gadget

* Cost reduced to 9000 (Down from 9500).
* Cooldown reduced to 15s (Down from 25s).

Three Tap Tommygun has proven to be an outlier in terms of output, so we're reducing the output and making it more difficult to quickly apply multiple stacks of. We're also improving some underused counter options, especially the Anti-Flier gadget.

#### Custom Game Updates

* Added an infinite Joyride option for Shion under Settings > Heroes > Shion.

#### Bug Fixes

General

* Fixed an issue causing Shion's Hero Challenges to not be sorted alphabetically.
* Fixed an issue with Mauga where his reticle spread could become inaccurate when swapping between his guns.
* Fixed an issue where Sierra’s Trailblazer drone could be interrupted by stun abilities.
* Fixed several text bugs in the Advanced Info Panel.

Stadium

* Fixed an issue where Junker Queen's Bloodhound Mask wasn't properly granting bonus Weapon Power from Wounds.
* Fixed an issue where Doomfist's Friendly Fissure caused Meteor Strike to deal full damage regardless of distance.
* Fixed an issue where Cassidy's Gunslinger Grit was triggering before the reload had completed.
* Fixed an issue where critically healing an ally after dealing Ability Damage with Cybervenom would apply Healing Reduction to allies.
* Fixed an issue where Lucio's Hip Hop wasn't properly working with Wall Jump on Release option toggled off.
* Fixed an issue where Mei's Frosting wasn't properly granting Ultimate Charge.
* Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Barrier wasn't scaling with Ability Power.
* Fixed an issue where Mei's Slowball would visually appear as though it was always the empowered projectile if the Power was sold while buff was active.
* Fixed an issue where Kiriko's Leaf on the Wind would target sometimes target enemies.
* In a previous update, fixed an issue where Moira's Spectral Beam had an incorrect effectiveness value.

#### 2026年夏季运动会

2026年夏季运动会现已上线，将你最爱的沙滩乱斗带回街机先锋！在动感球中尽情射门，在动感球混音版中火力全开，或在温斯顿的沙滩排球中享受发球乐趣，同时完成挑战，赢取火热的夏日战利品。在7月14日至30日的2026年夏季运动会中沐浴阳光，赢取闪耀的胜利吧！

#### 狂鼠的战利品狩猎

狂鼠的战利品狩猎将于7月31日至8月3日回归，为你带来奖励丰厚的周末狂欢！你进行的每一场比赛都会让你离补给更近一步，灵活的挑战让你既可以全力以赴，也可以按照自己的节奏进行。此外，进度不会重置，没有日常压力，也没有废话……只有爆炸，以及成堆的补给等你开启！

#### 挖掘计划

挖掘计划仍在继续，只需做你平时就在做的事——游玩《守望先锋》，即可获得奖励。在本赛季的剩余时间里，只需登录游戏、完成挑战、赢得比赛并每周保持活跃，就能获得补给。你玩得越多，就越有机会解锁装满奖励的基础、史诗和传说补给。

#### 英雄更新

#### 重装

![末日铁拳](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/c1eq/256X256/36dc867dd65cff81b5154c34531a9c520059c6f8c907631a6f99e049a6777dbb-t.png)

##### 末日铁拳

强化火箭重拳增加的后续判定大小会击中距离初始目标很远的敌人。我们正在减小这一额外判定大小，同时保留一些额外的射程和半径，以维持其力量感。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/OwEm/128X128/79fa2ac1beeaaecc23735e2bc41068a99838c76ff626a12ac07fcdc5efd70bd9-t.png)

火箭重拳

* 强化重拳的附带射程增益从75%降低至40%。
* 强化重拳的附带半径增益从50%降低至40%。

![渣客女王](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BRCr/256X256/a362b9dba4f5f4f704076945f3c72d7d442d536ffcc2fc5735062f4a1cee8031-t.png)

##### 渣客女王

命令怒吼是渣客女王生存和保护团队的主要手段。它的冷却时间在效果结束后才开始计算，导致两次使用之间的间隔较长。我们正在缩短其冷却时间，以提高其在交战中的可用性。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/TYKY/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-04-t.png)

命令怒吼

* 冷却时间从12秒缩短至10秒。（5v5）
* 冷却时间从15秒缩短至13秒。（6v6）

![毛加](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cI5S/256X256/937cbae13f50502b4191c09b7c178ef60d2eadddcdda5bc4268c1541216b8722-t.png)

##### 毛加

毛加在长时间使用单把机关枪开火时能够保持很高的精准度。为单把机关枪增加动态扩散，旨在鼓励玩家在武器之间切换以控制扩散。此项改动不会影响同时使用两把武器开火时的精准度。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/qcBJ/239X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-06-t.png)

链式步枪

* 使用单把机关枪开火时的最大扩散从1增加至1.5。
* 达到最大扩散所需的射击次数从0次增加至30次。

![拉玛刹](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/m8EN/256X256/f54a877264e161c2aa4d5755ef4411eb7fd7e4eb910075936e91ddb043b8a58e-t.png)

##### 拉玛刹

增加贪婪漩涡的爆炸伤害，以奖励更精准的引爆。我们还缩短了格挡的冷却时间，使拉玛刹能够在打出一拳（而不是两拳）后立即进行格挡，从而改善惩罚者形态的流畅度。

* 冷却时间从1秒缩短至0.5秒。

速射弩

* 射速从5增加至5.5。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/zTnk/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-67-t.png)

瞄准射击

* 恢复时间从0.5秒缩短至0.4秒。

死神生命值的减少限制了他在长时间交战中的续航能力。提高其被动技能的效果可以恢复部分生存能力，同时鼓励更具侵略性的打法。

收割

处决

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/rfGw/128X128/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-25-t.png)

![安娜](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/FfFC/256X256/3c87d470067d61c432815a4bc0c70b11f1b5379006da29625839da356b7c4ca1-t.png)

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/Z5wl/128X128/patch-2026-05-12-4b3a5430c9-04-t.png)

鼓舞士气

![雾子](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/Yazg/256X256/ee8089aae48680d912947d907295c03fce960dc500d806a400c36f59b6ef98d7-t.png)

缩短“符”的恢复时间改善了雾子治疗的手感和稳定性。然而，她的整体治疗量变得过高，因此我们在保留其出色响应速度的同时，降低了基础治疗量。

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/PmZ5/128X128/patch-2026-06-30-35f51ce1e6-147-t.png)

符

![卢西奥](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/cqpF/256X256/3a804d4305621bbee0e1472ac79d977799a27b6ae8f44922790cd1393812d5fd-t.png)

![](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261018/7JVs/160X132/patch-2026-07-14-3d7f1d6b86-33-t.png)

音速扩音器

角斗领域中的交锋模式回合可能会导致比赛时间过长，尤其是在双方阵容都具有高续航能力的情况下。因此，我们提高了目标点的占领速度，以限制这种极端情况的发生。

* 伤害从25减少至20。

![Cassidy](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/6VR5/256X256/5a0a0840565c5810d9a638d391b0403ba743459d52aa9f1c443a9fc87e41f06f-t.png)

减速球 - 异能

冰霜护甲 - 异能

* 转化为护甲的伤害从5%减少至3%。

铁匠 - 异能

### 《守望先锋》补丁说明——2026年7月15日

#### 2026年夏季运动会

2026年夏季运动会已经拉开帷幕，快回到大家最爱的街机先锋模式中，展开一场盛大的沙滩竞技！不论是动感斗球，精彩升级的动感斗球REMIX，还是温斯顿的沙滩排球，你都可以一边玩耍，一边完成挑战，赢得热力十足的夏日奖品。从7月15日至31日，在夏季运动会中尽情沐浴阳光，夺取最耀眼的胜利吧！

#### “狂鼠”的补给狩猎
